```{r init}
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)

SITES <- params$SITES
PATH <- params$DROPBOX

PLOT_FACTOR_LEVELS <- c("C", "F", "S",                # TMP plots
                        "UP", "SWAMP", "TR", "WTE", "W",       # synoptic plots
                        "F1", "F2", "F3", "R1", "R2") # DLG plots

# User can specify groups of synoptic sites: CB or LE
if(length(SITES == 1)) {
  if(SITES == "CB") {
    SITES <- c("SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW")
  } else if(SITES == "LE") {
    SITES <- c("PTR", "CRC", "OWC")
  } else if(SITES == "TESTING") {
    SITES <- c("SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW", "TMP", "OWC")
  }
}

# Well dimensions, for computing water level below surface
# This file, and the following code, are from the sensor data pipeline
WELL_DIMS_FILE <- "ancillary-data/well_dimensions.csv"
message("Reading ", WELL_DIMS_FILE)
WELL_DIMS <- readr::read_csv(WELL_DIMS_FILE,
                             comment = "#",
                             col_types = "ccccddcddddd")
WELL_DIMS$ground_to_sensor_cm <-
    with(WELL_DIMS, ring_to_pressure_sensor_cm -
             (well_top_to_ground_cm - bolt_to_cap_cm))
# TEMPEST trolls were installed differently; 2 parameters instead of 3
tmp <- WELL_DIMS$Site == "TMP"
WELL_DIMS$ground_to_sensor_cm[tmp] <- WELL_DIMS$Bolt_to_sensor_depth_cm[tmp] + WELL_DIMS$Bolt_to_ground_cm[tmp]

WELL_DIMS <- WELL_DIMS[c("Site", "Plot", "Instrument_ID", "ground_to_sensor_cm")]
# DELUGE AquaTROLL 200 wells are listed as DLG / F4 in well_dimensions.csv,
# but their data arrive as CRC / UP (logger 303): relabel to match the data
WELL_DIMS <- WELL_DIMS %>%
  mutate(is_dlg_f4 = Site == "DLG" & Plot == "F4",
         Site = if_else(is_dlg_f4, "CRC", Site),
         Plot = if_else(is_dlg_f4, "UP", Plot)) %>%
  select(-is_dlg_f4)

# Sapflow information. These files are from different places on the
# Google Drive and need to be munged to the same format
SF_TMP_FILE <- "ancillary-data/TEMPEST_SF_Monitoring.xlsx - Tracking.csv"
message("Reading ", SF_TMP_FILE)
sf_tmp <- read_csv(SF_TMP_FILE, col_types = "ccccccdd__c__")
SF_CB_FILE <- "ancillary-data/COMPASS_Synoptic_SF_Monitoring.xlsx - Tracking.csv"
message("Reading ", SF_CB_FILE)
sf_cb <- read_csv(SF_CB_FILE, col_types = "cccc_cdd__c__")
SF_LE_FILE <- "ancillary-data/LE_sapflow_inventory - Copy of Sheet1.csv"
message("Reading ", SF_LE_FILE)
sf_le <- read_csv(SF_LE_FILE, col_types = "ccdcdcc__")
sf_tmp %>%
  mutate(Site = "TMP") %>% 
  select(Site, Logger, Port, Sapflux_ID, Tree_ID) %>% 
  bind_rows(sf_cb %>% select(Site, Logger, Port, Sapflux_ID, Tree_ID)) %>% 
  bind_rows(sf_le %>% select(Site, Logger, Port, Sapflux_ID = Tree_Code, Tree_ID = Tag)) %>% 
  mutate(Tree = paste0(Sapflux_ID, " (", Tree_ID, ")")) %>% 
  select(-Sapflux_ID, -Tree_ID) ->
  SF_METADATA

# TEROS information, same deal
TEROS_TMP_FILE <- "ancillary-data/TEMPEST_TEROS_Network_Location&Status.csv"
message("Reading ", TEROS_TMP_FILE)
teros_tmp <- read_csv(TEROS_TMP_FILE, col_types = "c__ccdcc___d")
TEROS_CB_FILE <- "ancillary-data/COMPASS_Synoptic_Teros_Monitoring.csv"
message("Reading ", TEROS_CB_FILE)
teros_cb <- read_csv(TEROS_CB_FILE, col_types = "cc_cddc")
# TODO: where is LE file?
teros_tmp %>% 
  mutate(Site = "TMP",
         Plot = case_when(Plot == "Freshwater" ~ "F",
                          Plot == "Seawater" ~ "S",
                          Plot == "Control" ~ "C")) %>% 
  select(Site, Plot, Logger = `Data Logger ID`, Port = `Terosdata table channel`, ID, Depth_cm) %>% 
  bind_rows(teros_cb %>% select(Site, Plot = Zone, Logger, Port = Address, ID = `Probe ID`, Depth_cm = Depth)) %>% 
  mutate(Port = as.character(Port),
         Site = if_else(Site == "GCREW", "GCW", Site)) ->
  TEROS_METADATA
```

Sites: `r paste(SITES, collapse = ", ")`

Data path: `r PATH`

```{r helper-functions}
#| include: false

# Insert an HTML banner if no data
no_data_check <- function(x, what) {
  message("Total: ", nrow(x), " data rows")
  if(nrow(x) == 0) {
    cat('::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}',
        '## No Data',
        '',
        paste('No data files were found for', what),
        '',
        ':::', sep = "\n")
  }
}

# Read a raw datalogger file. This is copied from the sensor data pipeline code
read_datalogger_file <- function(filename, quiet = TRUE, ...) {

    # Parse line one to extract logger and table names
    dat <- read_lines(filename)
    if(!quiet) message("\t- ", basename(filename), " (", length(dat)-4, " rows)")
    header_split <- strsplit(dat[1], ",")[[1]]
    header_split <- gsub("\"", "", header_split) # remove quotation marks
    format_name <- header_split[1] # first field of row 1
    logger_name <- header_split[2] # second field of row 1
    table_name <- header_split[length(header_split)]

    x <- read_csv(I(dat[-c(1, 3, 4)]), 
                  show_col_types = FALSE, 
                  na = c("NAN", "-99999", ""))
    # Remove inconsistent and/or not useful columns
    x$Statname <- x$PB <- x$RECORD <- NULL
    # Some Aquatroll tables (specifically at OWC; see e.g. #21) have blank
    # tables, and their "Aquatroll_IDx" columns get parsed as numeric, which
    # causes errors at the bind_rows() step below. Pre-emptively fix this
    
    #fixcol <- grep("^Aquatroll_ID", colnames(x))
    #if(length(fixcol) > 0) x[fixcol] <- as.character(x[fixcol])
    
    # (adding this same problem for DLG Aquatroll_ID, Aquatroll200_ID(2,1),
    #  Aquatroll600_ID) to character.
    fixcol <- grep("^Aquatroll[0-9]*_ID", colnames(x))
    if(length(fixcol) > 0) x[fixcol] <- lapply(x[fixcol], as.character)
    
    info <- tibble(Logger_raw = rep(logger_name, nrow(x)),
                   Table = rep(table_name, nrow(x)))
    as_tibble(cbind(info, x))
}

# Find and read raw data files
read_files <- function(type, sitelist = SITES, path = PATH) {
  
  # Loop through the sites and load files
  sitedat <- list()
  for(site in sitelist) {
    # Figure out where this site's files are
    if(site == "DLG") {
      SUBPATH <- "COMPASS_PNNL_Data"
      CURRENT <- "current_data"
      PATTERN <- paste0(site, "-.*_[0-9]+_", type)
    } else if(site %in% c("PTR", "CRC", "OWC", "SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW")) {
      SUBPATH <- "COMPASS_PNNL_Data"
      CURRENT <- "current_data"
      PATTERN <- paste0("_", site, "_.*_", type)
    } else if(site == "TMP") {
      SUBPATH <- "TEMPEST_PNNL_Data"
      CURRENT <- "Current_data" # you're killing me, Roy
      PATTERN <- paste0("_", type)
    } else {
      stop("Unknown site: ", site)
    }
    
    files <- list.files(file.path(path, SUBPATH, CURRENT), 
                        pattern = PATTERN,
                        ignore.case = TRUE, # TMP has different capitalization
                        full.names = TRUE)
    if(any(grepl("backup$", files))) {
      message(site, ": ignoring backup file(s)")
      files <- files[grep("backup$", files, invert = TRUE)]      
    }
    filetext <- if_else(length(files) == 1, " file", " files")
    message(site, ": found ", length(files), filetext)
    x <- lapply(files, read_datalogger_file)
    x <- bind_rows(x)
    if(nrow(x) == 0) next # no data!

    # Split "Logger_raw" field into "Site", "Plot", and "Logger"
    if(site == "DLG") {
      # The DLG data files have logger_raw with format DLG-{PLOT}_{LOGGER}
      x %>% 
        separate(Logger_raw, into = c("Site", "Plot", "Logger"), remove = TRUE) ->
        x
    } else if(site == "TMP") {
      # The TMP data files have logger_raw with format PNNL_{LOGGER}
      x %>% 
        separate(Logger_raw, into = c("Site", "Logger"), remove = TRUE) %>% 
        mutate(Site = "TMP",
               Plot = case_when(Logger %in% c("11", "12", "13") ~ "C",
                                Logger %in% c("21", "22", "23") ~ "F",
                                Logger %in% c("31", "32", "33") ~ "S")) ->
        x
    } else {
      # The synoptic sites have format Compass_{SITE}_{PLOT}_{LOGGER}
      x %>% 
        separate(Logger_raw, into = c("Junk", "Site", "Plot", "Logger"), 
                 fill = "right", # we need this because Buoy data have no logger info
                 remove = TRUE) %>%
        select(-Junk) ->
        x
    }
    
    # Change Plot to a factor and reorder columns
    x %>% mutate(Plot = factor(Plot, levels = PLOT_FACTOR_LEVELS)) ->
      x
    left_cols <- c("Site", "Plot", "Logger", "Table")
    x <- bind_cols(select(x, all_of(left_cols)), select(x, -all_of(left_cols)))
    
    sitedat[[site]] <- x
    
  } # for site
  bind_rows(sitedat, .id = "Site")
}

# Pivot wide Campbell format to long
pivotstep <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    pivot_longer(-1:-5) %>% 
    filter(name != "BattV_Avg") # we probably don't care about this
}

# Make a nice string, robust to all NA/NaN, for a vector's range
robust_range <- function(x, digits) {
  if(any(!is.na(x))) {
    return(paste(round(range(x, na.rm = TRUE), digits = digits), collapse = "-"))
  } else {
    return("-")
  }
}
```

```{r sf-plots}
if(nrow(sf) > 0) {
```

# TEROS

```{r teros-read}
#| output: "asis"
teros <- read_files("Teros") 
no_data_check(teros, "TEROS")
```

```{r teros-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

#splitting DELUGE (CRC UP) Teros 21 and stem Teros from the check graphs
teros_soil <- teros %>% filter(grepl("^TerosTable|^Teros12Table$", Table))
teros21    <- teros %>% filter(Table == "Teros21Table")
teros_stem <- teros %>% filter(Table == "Stem_Teros12Table")

# Sensor labels per TEROS type (measurement index -> name)
# Stem TEROS 12 labels confirmed by the logger programmer (Nov 2026)
SOIL_LABELS <- c("1" = "VWC", 
                 "2" = "Temp", 
                 "3" = "EC")
T21_LABELS  <- c("1" = "WaterPotential", 
                 "2" = "Temp")
STEM_LABELS <- c("1" = "VWC_counts", 
                 "2" = "Temp", 
                 "3" = "EC", 
 # Stem TEROS 12 derived variables (computed in the logger program)
 # Measurement 4 - bulk dielectric permittivity (eps_b), METER equation,
 # from calibratedCountsVWC (RAW, measurement 1):
 # eps_b = (2.887e-9 * RAW^3 - 2.080e-5 * RAW^2 + 5.276e-2 * RAW - 43.39)^2
                 "4" = "Dielectric", 
 # Measurement 5 - species-weighted VWC (m3/m3), linear calibration on eps_b:
 #   VWC_species = m * eps_b + b
 #
 #   Species                     m       b       R2
 #   Acer saccharinum            0.019   0.010   0.849
 #   Quercus rubra               0.029  -0.115   0.952
 #   Quercus rubra (shortened)   0.048  -0.060   0.957
 #
 # Port -> species, as set in the logger program (m(k), b(k)):
 #   PB 304/305/307: ports 1-3 Acer saccharinum; 4-6 Quercus rubra (shortened);
 #                   7-9 Quercus rubra
 #   PB 303/308:     port 1 Quercus rubra; ports 2-3 Quercus rubra (shortened);
 #                   port 4 Quercus rubra
                 "5" = "VWC_species") 

process_teros <- function(df, label, pattern, labels) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  long <- df %>%
    pivotstep() %>% 
    # bind_rows() gives every table the columns of all other tables (filled
    # with NA), so keep only the columns that belong to this TEROS type
    filter(grepl(pattern, name)) %>%
    # NA value is -99999.00
    mutate(value = if_else(value %in% c(-9999, -99999), NA_real_, value),
           # Strip everything up to "(" (handles "Stem_Teros12(" too) and ")"
           name = gsub("^.*\\(", "", name),
           name = gsub(")", "", name)) %>%
    separate(name, into = c("Port", "sensor"), convert = FALSE) %>%
    # Ports 3 and 4 in W are not installed (constant zeros, no metadata)
    filter(!(Plot == "W" & Port %in% c("3", "4"))) %>%
        left_join(TEROS_METADATA, by = c("Site", "Plot", "Logger", "Port")) %>%
    # The join changes Plot back to character
    mutate(Plot = factor(Plot, levels = PLOT_FACTOR_LEVELS),
           Depth_cm = as.factor(Depth_cm),
           sensor_name = unname(labels[sensor])) 
    
  current <- filter(long, TIMESTAMP >= Sys.time() - days(7),
                    TIMESTAMP <= Sys.time())
  if (nrow(current) == 0) {
    message(label, ": no data in the last 7 days")
    return(list(long = long, plots = list(), table = NULL))
  }
  
  # TEROS 21 and stem sensors have no depth in the metadata: color by port
  # Stem sensors are not in TEROS_METADATA (soil depths): always color by port
  color_var <- if (grepl("Stem", label) || all(is.na(current$Depth_cm))) "Port" else "Depth_cm"
  
  plots <- map(set_names(unique(current$Site)), function(s) {
    ggplot(filter(current, Site == s),
           aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
      facet_grid(sensor_name ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
      ggtitle(paste(s, label))
  })
  
  # Summary table for the last 7 days
  table <- current %>%
    group_by(Site, Plot, sensor_name) %>%
    summarise(N_sensor = n_distinct(Port),
              Mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              SD = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              Range = robust_range(value, 1),
              N_values = n(),
              N_na = sum(is.na(value)),
              .groups = "drop")
  
  list(long = long, plots = plots, table = table)
}
# Run the same pipeline for the three TEROS types
res <- pmap(list(
  df      = list(teros_soil, teros21, teros_stem),
  label   = c("TEROS 12 soil", "TEROS 21 soil", "Stem TEROS 12"),
  pattern = c("^Teros[ABC]\\(|^Teros12\\(", "^Teros21\\(", "^Stem_Teros12\\("),
  labels  = list(SOIL_LABELS, T21_LABELS, STEM_LABELS)
), process_teros) %>%
  set_names(c("TEROS 12 soil", "TEROS 21 soil", "Stem TEROS 12"))

# Print plots and summary tables for each type
# Print plots for each TEROS type (tables are in the teros-table chunk)
walk(res, ~ if (!is.null(.x)) walk(.x$plots, print))
```

# AquaTROLL

```{r troll-read}
#| output: "asis"
troll <- read_files("WaterLevel")
no_data_check(troll, "AquaTROLL")
```

```{r troll-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8
if(nrow(troll) > 0) {
  troll %>% 
    select(-starts_with("Aquatroll")) %>% # remove text column
    pivotstep() %>% 
    # NA values are -9999 or -99999
    mutate(value = if_else(value %in% c(-9999, -99999), NA_real_, value)) -> 
    troll_long
  
  # Ugh, of course TMP trolls are totally different. Handle
  if("TMP" %in% troll_long$Site) {
    troll_long %>% 
      filter(Site == "TMP") %>% 
      # hard coded, crappy, sorry
      mutate(Instrument_ID = 
               case_when(Logger == "12" & Table == "WaterLevel200" ~ "683451",
                         Logger == "13" & Table == "WaterLevel600" ~ "685442",
                         Logger == "21" & Table == "WaterLevel200" ~ "683416",
                         Logger == "23" & Table == "WaterLevel200" ~ "683345",
                         Logger == "23" & Table == "WaterLevel600" ~ "685474",
                         Logger == "31" & Table == "WaterLevel200" ~ "683408",
                         Logger == "32" & Table == "WaterLevel600" ~ "685410")) ->
      troll_long_tmp
  } else {
    troll_long_tmp <- NULL
  }
  
  troll_long %>% 
    filter(Site != "TMP") %>% 
    # AquaTROLL 600 tables use the A/B/C suffix of the table name
    mutate(Instrument_ID = substr(Table, nchar(Table), nchar(Table)),
    # OWC: the WTE AquaTROLL (A) is wired to the UP logger (323); relabel plot
           Plot = if_else(Site == "OWC" & Logger == "323" & Instrument_ID == "A",
                          "WTE", as.character(Plot))) %>% 
    # AquaTROLL 200: 9 sensor slots with suffix A-I on each variable;
    # sensor letter position = Instrument_ID in well_dimensions.csv (A=1 ... I=9)
    mutate(Sensor200 = if_else(Table == "WaterLevel200",
                               sub(".*_([A-I])$", "\\1", name), NA_character_),
           Instrument_ID = if_else(Table == "WaterLevel200",
                                   as.character(match(Sensor200, LETTERS)),
                                   Instrument_ID)) %>%
    # AquaTROLL 200: only sensor E is installed at CRC UP; drop empty slots A-D, F-I
    filter(Table != "WaterLevel200" | Sensor200 == "E") %>%
    # add TMP data back in
    bind_rows(troll_long_tmp) %>% 
    # label instrument model from the table name (works for TMP too)
    mutate(Instrument = if_else(grepl("200", Table), 
                                "AquaTROLL 200", "AquaTROLL 600")) %>%
    # remove "600" with optional A/B/C, or the "_A".."_I" suffix of AquaTROLL 200
    mutate(name = gsub("([26]00[ABC]?|_[A-Z])$", "", name)) %>%
    # compute water level
    left_join(WELL_DIMS, by = c("Site", "Plot", "Instrument_ID")) %>% 
    # the join changes Plot back to character
    mutate(Plot = factor(Plot, levels = PLOT_FACTOR_LEVELS)) %>% 
    # filter per SW: WL, temp, salinity, DO, and pH
    filter(name %in% c("Temperature", "Salinity", "RDO_concen",
                       "pH", "Water_Density", "Pressure", "Depth")) ->
    troll_long
  
  # Compute water level. For each Site, Plot, and Instrument_ID, 
  # extract the pressure, density, and ground_to_sensor info
  troll_long %>% 
    filter(name %in% c("Water_Density", "Pressure"), !is.na(value)) %>% 
    # Sometimes there's more than one value per timestep; average those away
    group_by(Site, Plot, Logger, Table, TIMESTAMP, name, Instrument_ID, 
             ground_to_sensor_cm) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name") -> wl
  
  # Make sure the density column exists even if no instrument reported it
  if(!"Water_Density" %in% names(wl)) wl$Water_Density <- NA_real_
  
  wl %>% 
    # This follows Peter Regier's code, and Fausto M-S's logic
    # Fall back to density = 1 when density is missing or out of range
    mutate(density_gcm3_cor = if_else(!is.na(Water_Density) &
                                        Water_Density >= 0.98 & Water_Density <= 1.05, 
                                      Water_Density, 1),
           pressure_mbar = if_else(Pressure == -99999, 0, Pressure),
           pressurehead_m = (pressure_mbar * 100) / (density_gcm3_cor * 1000 * 9.80665),
           water_level_cm = round(100 * pressurehead_m - ground_to_sensor_cm, 1)) %>% 
    select(Site, Plot, Instrument_ID, TIMESTAMP, water_level_cm) -> 
    wl
  
  # join is many-to-one: many names at a given timestamp
  troll_long %>% 
    left_join(wl, by = c("Site", "Plot", "Instrument_ID", "TIMESTAMP"),
              relationship = "many-to-one") ->
    troll_long
  
  troll_long_current <- troll_long %>%
    filter(TIMESTAMP >= Sys.time() - days(7),
           TIMESTAMP <= Sys.time()) %>%
    # Water level status for coloring; "No well dimensions" when the well is
    # missing from well_dimensions.csv
    mutate(WL_status = case_when(is.na(ground_to_sensor_cm) ~ "No well dimensions",
                                 water_level_cm < -ground_to_sensor_cm ~ "Below sensor",
                                 TRUE ~ "OK"))
  
  WL_COLORS <- c("OK" = "black", "Below sensor" = "red", "No well dimensions" = "grey60")
  
  # AquaTROLL 600: one plot per variable
  x600 <- filter(troll_long_current, Instrument == "AquaTROLL 600")
  if(nrow(x600) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(x600, aes(TIMESTAMP, water_level_cm, color = WL_status)) +
      facet_grid(Site ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_color_manual("WL below sensor", values = WL_COLORS) +
      ggtitle("AquaTROLL 600 - water_level_cm") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
    print(p)
    
    for(nm in unique(x600$name)) {
      p <- ggplot(filter(x600, name == nm), aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = WL_status)) +
        facet_grid(Site ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
        ylab(nm) +
        ggtitle(paste("AquaTROLL 600 -", nm)) +
        scale_color_manual("WL below sensor", values = WL_COLORS) +
        geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
      print(p)
    }
  }
  
  # AquaTROLL 200 (CRC UP, sensor E): all variables in a single panel figure
  # AquaTROLL 200 has no DO (RDO) or pH sensors: drop them from its panel
  x200 <- filter(troll_long_current, Instrument == "AquaTROLL 200",
                 !name %in% c("RDO_concen", "pH"))
  if(nrow(x200) > 0) {
    x200_all <- bind_rows(
      x200,
      x200 %>% distinct(Site, Plot, TIMESTAMP, water_level_cm, WL_status) %>%
        mutate(name = "water_level_cm", value = water_level_cm)
    )
    p <- ggplot(x200_all, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = WL_status)) +
      facet_grid(name ~ paste(Site, Plot), scales = "free_y") +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_color_manual("WL below sensor", values = WL_COLORS) +
      ylab(NULL) +
      ggtitle("AquaTROLL 200") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

```{r troll-tables}

if(nrow(troll) > 0) {
  troll_long_current %>% 
    # Keep AquaTROLL 200 without DO/pH (not measured by that model)
    filter(!(Instrument == "AquaTROLL 200" & name %in% c("RDO_concen", "pH"))) %>%
    group_by(Site, Instrument, Plot, name) %>% 
    summarise(N_sensor = length(unique(Instrument_ID)), 
              Mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
              SD = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
              Range = robust_range(value, 3),
              N_values = n(), 
              N_na = sum(is.na(value)), 
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # One gt row group per site and instrument (e.g. "CRC - AquaTROLL 200")
    mutate(Group = paste(Site, "-", Instrument)) %>%
    select(-Site, -Instrument) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Group", row_group_as_column = TRUE) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c("Mean", "SD"), decimals = 1) %>% 
    fmt_number(columns = c("N_sensor", "N_values", "N_na"), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE)
}
```

# Redox

```{r redox-read}
#| output: "asis"
redox <- read_files("Redox") 
no_data_check(redox, "Redox")
```

```{r redox-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8

#redox colors 
#redox_colors <- c("darkgoldenrod1", "darkorange", "chocolate4",
 #                 "chartreuse2", "green4", "palegreen2", 
  #                "deepskyblue1", "dodgerblue3", "blue1", 
   #               "darkorchid2", "orchid3", "mediumpurple4")

redox_assignments <- tribble(~number, ~Depth, ~Rep,
                             1,        10,     1,  
                             2,        15,     1,    
                             3,        30,     1,    
                             4,        45,     1,   
                             5,        10,     2,   
                             6,        15,     2,   
                             7,        30,     2,    
                             8,        45,     2,     
                             9,        10,     3,    
                             10,       15,     3,    
                             11,       30,     3,    
                             12,       45,     3)


if(nrow(redox) > 0) {
  redox %>% 
    select(-BattV) %>% 
    filter(Table == "Redox15") %>%  # per SJW: only look at 15 minutes data
    pivotstep() %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("which", "number"), extra = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(number = as.numeric(number)) %>% 
    left_join(redox_assignments, by = "number") %>% 
    mutate(Depth = as.factor(Depth)) %>%
    mutate(Depth_Rep = as.factor(paste(Depth, Rep, sep = "-"))) ->
    redox_long
  
redox_long_current <- redox_long %>%
      filter(
    TIMESTAMP >= Sys.time() - days(7),
    TIMESTAMP <= Sys.time()
  )
  
  
  for(site in unique(redox_long_current$Site)) {
    redox_site <- filter(redox_long_current, Site == site)
    p <- ggplot(redox_site, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = Depth_Rep)) +
      facet_grid(which ~ Plot) +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      #scale_color_manual(values = redox_colors) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
      ggtitle(paste(site, "Redox"))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

```{r redox-table}
              SD = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
              Range = robust_range(value, 3),
              N_values = n(), 
              N_na = sum(is.na(value)), 
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    gt(groupname_col = "Site", row_group_as_column = TRUE) %>%
```
